title: Ɲɛgɛn denmisɛnnu dilanni yɔrɔ la
summary: Ka ɲɛgɛn dilanni fɛɛrɛ sugandi (kɔnɔkow ka taalo, terini, dugukolo ɲɛgɛn dilanni), ka dugukolo-jiri-ɲɛgɛn-jugu dilan min falen bɛ nafa la, ka dibi ni ji bɔli kɛcogo ɲɛnabɔ.

pages.title: DUGUKOLO KAN
pages.text:
DUGUKOLO KAN O KUN JOLI KAN K'A FARA FEN WERE KAN

I yɛlɛnna i ka jiriw dilanni na, fɛɛrɛ saba de bɛ fɛn caman na minnu bɛ fɛn caman na:

1) Jiriw dilan dugukolo kan jiri yɔrɔ la.
2) Jiriw dilan dugukolo kan jiri yɔrɔ la.
3) Jiriw fara kɔnɔko la ka tɛmɛn u kan ka u sigi yɔrɔ wɛrɛ la.

Fɛɛrɛ kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ ni a ka nafa ni a ka tɔɔrɔ ye. An bɛna a jira i la cogo min na i ka sugandi i ka fɛnɲɛnɛmaw kɔnɔ!

pages.title: WALIMA
pages.text:
**Jololi ye mun ye?**

Denmisɛnw bɛ fara fɔlɔ duguma walima dugukɔnɔ, o kɔfɛ u bɛ jololi kɛ kɔnɔna kɔnɔ ka tɛmɛn u sigili laban na.

O ye baara ye min bɛ kɛ tuma caman na yiri denmisɛnw ni fɛnɲɛnama jikuruw ka jikuruw kama.

pages.title: I yɛ ka fɛn ninnu sɔrɔ:
pages.text:
- **Kɔntɛni** walima **plastiki saki**
- **Dugu-jiri** min falen bɛ **nafolo** la 🪴 🌱

- Juri ka fanga ka bon
- Yɛlɛma kɔfɛ, a ka dɛsɛ ka nɔgɔn
- Waati dɔgɔya yoroko la
- Ji-baara dɔgɔya ✅ ✅ ✅ ✅ Munyu-kɔrɔta ka teli minnu ye?

- Baara kura
- Stress ka teli ni a ma munyu-kɔrɔta kaɲa ❌ ❌
